trials.title: Phase II Trial of Chemotherapy in Sporadic and Neurofibromatosis Type 1 Associated High Grade Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
trials.evidence: Direct NF1 + doxorubicin trial for malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors. Completed trial using doxorubicin as part of combination chemotherapy in NF1 patients.
trials.relevance: Only identified trial directly testing doxorubicin in NF1 context

trials.title: Cardioprotection With Dexrazoxane in Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML), High-Risk Myelodysplastic Syndrome (MDS)
trials.evidence: Active trial testing dexrazoxane cardioprotection with anthracycline chemotherapy. Gold standard cardioprotective agent.
trials.relevance: Dexrazoxane mechanism applicable to NF1 patients receiving doxorubicin

trials.title: ANTICIPATE: Prevention of ANThracycline-Induced Cardiac Dysfunction by Dexrazoxane In PATients With diffusE Large B-cell Lymphoma
trials.drug: dexrazoxane + R-CHOP (rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, prednisolone)
trials.evidence: Phase III prevention trial specifically designed to evaluate dexrazoxane cardioprotection with doxorubicin. National multicenter RCT.
trials.relevance: Large-scale validation of dexrazoxane cardioprotection strategy applicable to NF1
conditions: DLBCL - Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma

trials.title: Prevention of Heart Failure Induced by Doxorubicin With Early Administration of Dexrazoxane in Patients With Breast Cancer
trials.evidence: Completed trial examining early (preventive) dexrazoxane administration with doxorubicin. Evaluated Top2b degradation mechanisms.
trials.relevance: Mechanistic evidence for dexrazoxane preventing doxorubicin cardiotoxicity

trials.title: Response Dependent Treatment of Stages IA, IIA and IIIA Hodgkin's Disease With DBVE and Low Dose Involved Field Irradiation With or Without Zinecard
trials.evidence: Pediatric Oncology Group Phase III study testing dexrazoxane cardioprotection. Completed landmark trial.
trials.relevance: Pediatric evidence for dexrazoxane safety and efficacy with doxorubicin

trials.title: Evaluation of the Effectiveness of Empagliflozin in the Prevention of Cardiotoxicity in Cancer Patients Undergoing Chemotherapy Based on Anthracyclines (EMPACT Study)
trials.evidence: Novel SGLT2 inhibitor approach to cardioprotection. Active trial evaluating empagliflozin prevention of anthracycline cardiotoxicity.
trials.relevance: Alternative cardioprotection mechanism (metabolic/mitochondrial) applicable to NF1

trials.title: Clinical Study to Evaluate the Possible Safety and Efficacy of Dapagliflozin in the Prophylaxis of Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity in Breast Cancer Patients
trials.evidence: Active recruitment for SGLT2 inhibitor cardioprotection with doxorubicin specifically.
trials.relevance: SGLT2i mechanism relevant to mitochondrial dysfunction in NF1

trials.title: Clinical Study to Evaluate the Possible Safety and Efficacy of Fenofibrate in the Prophylaxis of Doxorubicin Induced Cardiotoxicity in Breast Cancer Patients
trials.evidence: Completed trial of PPARα agonist for cardioprotection. Fenofibrate targets lipid metabolism and mitochondrial function.

trials.title: Evaluation of the Impact of Alpha Lipoic Acid Administration on the Prevention of Doxorubicin-induced Cardiotoxicity in Breast Cancer Patients
trials.evidence: Completed trial of antioxidant cardioprotection. Alpha lipoic acid is mitochondrial antioxidant.
trials.relevance: Antioxidant mechanism directly relevant to NF1 oxidative stress hypothesis

trials.title: Prevention Using Exercise Rehabilitation to Offset Cardiac Toxicities Induced Via Chemotherapy
trials.evidence: Completed trial of exercise as cardioprotection during doxorubicin treatment.
trials.relevance: Non-pharmacological cardioprotection approach with completed results

trials.title: Role of Statin Therapy in Prevention of Anthracycline-Induced Cardiotoxicity
trials.evidence: Trial investigating statin cardioprotection through anti-inflammatory and vascular mechanisms.
trials.relevance: Statin pleiotropic effects may benefit NF1 vascular complications

trials.title: Efficacy of Telmisartan in Preventing Doxorubicin-induced Cardiotoxicity in Breast Cancer Patients
trials.evidence: Planned trial of ARB cardioprotection. Telmisartan blocks angiotensin-mediated cardiac stress.
trials.relevance: Renin-angiotensin system modulation may protect against doxorubicin cardiotoxicity

trials.title: A Phase I/II Study of the Mitogen Activated Protein Kinase (MEK) 1 Inhibitor Selumetinib (AZD6244) in Children With Neurofibromatosis Type 1 (NF1) and Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas (PN)
trials.evidence: Landmark NF1 trial establishing selumetinib efficacy for plexiform neurofibromas. Does NOT combine with chemotherapy.
trials.relevance: Demonstrates MEK inhibitor activity in NF1, but no doxorubicin combination data

trials.title: Phase II Trial of the MEK1/2 Inhibitor Selumetinib (AZD6244 Hydrogen Sulfate in Adults With Neurofibromatosis Type 1 (NF1) and Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas
trials.evidence: Adult NF1 trial of selumetinib monotherapy for plexiform neurofibromas.
trials.relevance: Establishes selumetinib safety in adult NF1 population, no chemotherapy combination

trials.title: SARC031: A Phase 2 Trial of the MEK Inhibitor Selumetinib (AZD6244 Hydrogen Sulfate) in Combination With the mTOR Inhibitor Sirolimus for Patients With Unresectable or Metastatic Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
trials.evidence: Completed NF1-associated MPNST trial combining MEK + mTOR inhibition. No chemotherapy.
trials.relevance: Demonstrates feasibility of MEK inhibitor combinations in NF1 malignancies

trials.title: Phase 1/2 Trial of the MEK Inhibitor Selumetinib and Bromodomain Inhibitor ZEN-3694 With Durvalumab (MEDI4736), a PD-L1 Antibody for Sarcomas Including Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
trials.evidence: Active trial combining MEK inhibitor + BET inhibitor + immunotherapy for NF1-associated MPNST.
trials.relevance: Tests BET inhibitor combination in NF1 context (ZEN-3694), but no chemotherapy

trials.title: Early Phase Study to Evaluate the MEK Inhibitor Selumetinib With the MDM2 Inhibitor APG-115 in Patients With Neurofibromatosis Type 1 and Pre-malignant and Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
trials.evidence: Active early phase trial combining MEK + MDM2 inhibition in NF1 MPNST.
trials.relevance: Novel combination for NF1 malignancies, no chemotherapy component

trials.title: Exploratory Evaluation of AR-42 Histone Deacetylase Inhibitor in the Treatment of Vestibular Schwannoma and Meningioma
trials.evidence: TERMINATED trial of HDAC inhibitor for NF2-related tumors (not NF1). No combination with chemotherapy.
trials.relevance: Limited - NF2 not NF1, terminated early, no chemotherapy

trials.title: MRD-positive AML: a Prospective, Single-arm, Multicenter Platform Clinical Study
trials.evidence: Active AML trial using trametinib (MEK inhibitor) + anthracycline chemotherapy combination. Not NF1-specific.
trials.relevance: Demonstrates MEK inhibitor + anthracycline combination is being tested clinically (in AML)

key_findings.nf1_doxorubicin_evidence: Only 1 completed Phase II trial (NCT00304083) directly tested doxorubicin in NF1 patients with malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors. No cardioprotection strategy mentioned.
key_findings.cardioprotection_landscape: Dexrazoxane is gold standard with 5 identified trials (3 completed, 2 recruiting). Multiple alternative strategies have clinical data: SGLT2 inhibitors (empagliflozin, dapagliflozin), fenofibrate, alpha lipoic acid, statins, ARBs, and exercise.
key_findings.mek_inhibitor_status: Selumetinib extensively studied in NF1 (35 trials) for plexiform neurofibromas and low-grade gliomas, but ZERO trials combine MEK inhibitors with chemotherapy in NF1 context. One AML trial (NCT07131059) combines trametinib + anthracyclines.
key_findings.hdac_inhibitor_gap: Only 1 HDAC inhibitor trial found (AR-42 for NF2, terminated). No HDAC inhibitor trials in NF1.
key_findings.parp_inhibitor_gap: No PARP inhibitor trials identified in NF1.
key_findings.bet_inhibitor_status: BET inhibitor ZEN-3694 being tested with selumetinib in NF1 MPNST (NCT05253131), but no chemotherapy combination.
key_findings.antioxidant_trials: Alpha lipoic acid has completed trial data for doxorubicin cardioprotection (NCT06703593).
key_findings.nrf2_sod2_gap: No clinical trials identified for NRF2 activators (bardoxolone) or SOD2 mimetics (GC4419) with doxorubicin.

critical_gaps: NO trials combining MEK inhibitors + doxorubicin in NF1
NO trials testing PARP inhibitors in NF1 (despite synthetic lethality hypothesis)
NO trials testing HDAC inhibitors in NF1 (only NF2)
NO trials of NRF2 activators in NF1
NO trials of SOD2 mimetics in NF1
NO trials of NAC (N-acetylcysteine) with doxorubicin in NF1
Dexrazoxane well-established for cardioprotection but NOT tested in NF1 patients
SGLT2 inhibitors promising for cardioprotection but NOT tested in NF1
translational_opportunities: Test dexrazoxane + doxorubicin in NF1 MPNST (apply proven cardioprotection to NF1)
Evaluate selumetinib + doxorubicin + dexrazoxane triple combination in NF1 malignancies
Trial SGLT2 inhibitors (empagliflozin/dapagliflozin) for cardioprotection in NF1 patients receiving anthracyclines
Investigate alpha lipoic acid or other antioxidants in NF1 given oxidative stress mechanisms
Test PARP inhibitors in NF1 based on synthetic lethality predictions
Evaluate HDAC inhibitors in NF1 context (currently only NF2 data)
Combine MEK inhibition with chemotherapy in NF1 MPNST (precedent from AML trial NCT07131059)
